# Flex

The `Flex` component simplifies usage of the css [flexbox](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/CSS_Flexible_Box_Layout) model.

This component does not manage fixed spacing between childs. For this, use the <LinkTo kind="Components/Inline" story="basic">Inline</LinkTo> or <LinkTo kind="Components/Stack" story="basic">Stack</LinkTo> components.

## Examples

### Wrap
